Idrottsföreningen Brommapojkarna, more commonly known as Brommapojkarna or simply BP, is a Swedish professional football club based in the borough of Bromma, in the western parts of Stockholm municipality. Brommapojkarna is the largest football club in Europe in terms of the number of active youth teams. The men's team plays in the Allsvenskan. The club is famous for its youth academy, which has produced numerous top-quality Swedish players throughout the years. It is affiliated to the Stockholms Fotbollförbund.
